title: PixelValley
description: A modern Minecraft network featuring Lifesteal, custom gameplay, crossplay support, voice chat, economy systems, events, and an optimized lag-free experience for both Java & Bedrock players.
body:
Welcome to **PixelValley** — a next-generation Minecraft network built for players who want smooth gameplay, competitive features, and an active community.

Dive into an enhanced survival experience with custom systems, optimized performance, exciting events, and cross-platform support for both Java & Bedrock players. Whether you're grinding, building, PvPing, or just chilling with friends, PixelValley delivers a polished and community-driven adventure.

### Features

• Lifesteal & custom gameplay mechanics
• Java + Bedrock Crossplay Support
• Simple Voice Chat Support
• Optimized lag-free experience
• Active staff & frequent updates
• Community events and giveaways
• Economy, auctions, teams, and more

### Join Now

**IP:** `play.pixelvalley.fun`
**Bedrock Port:** `19132`

Start your journey and become part of the PixelValley community today.
